'''VR simulators''' were devices used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] for training purposes. Stormtrooper [[Davin Felth/Legends|Davin Felth's]] VR simulator training helped him to prepare an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] for departure.<ref name="When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale" />
